Billund is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, specifically focusing on Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment using data from DanStroke and the National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. Billund's specific data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is presented in a municipal breakdown designed to support local quality development and benchmarking across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists of a single tabular mention, no further historical, relational, or descriptive details are documented in this corpus.
